view: Frontal chest radiograph (PA/erect), R marker present at the image upper-left confirming conventional orientation
technical_quality: Adequate. Minimal rotation (spinous processes approximately midway between clavicular heads), adequate inspiration (~9-10 posterior ribs), adequate penetration with vertebral bodies faintly visible behind the heart. Scapulae partially project over the upper lateral lung fields. Whole thorax and both costophrenic angles included.

devices.type: Subcutaneous implanted venous access port (chest port / Port-A-Cath) reservoir
devices.location: Right upper anterior chest wall, overlying the right 2nd-3rd anterior rib interspace

Courses from the right chest wall port cranially over the right clavicle into the right neck (right internal jugular approach), then descends along the right paratracheal mediastinum; tip projects over the lower SVC / cavoatrial junction
Image upper-left: 'R' side marker with small alphanumeric label

abnormalities.finding: Well-defined rounded nodular opacity approximately 2.5 cm, lateral to the left hilum, suspicious for a pulmonary nodule/mass
Ill-defined hazy increased opacity in the right perihilar region, suggesting right hilar prominence / possible hilar mass or adenopathy
Left hilum appears mildly prominent / dense

description_zh: 胸部正面X光片,右側前胸壁可見皮下植入式靜脈注射座(Port-A-Cath),導管經右頸靜脈路徑下行,尖端位於下腔上靜脈/心房交界處。左肺中葉區(左肺門外側)可見一約2.5公分邊界清楚之圓形結節狀陰影,疑為肺結節或腫塊;右肺門周圍亦見模糊之密度增加,不排除右肺門腫大或淋巴結病變,左肺門亦略顯突出。心臟大小正常,縱膈無明顯偏移或增寬,雙側肋膈角清晰,無氣胸或肋膜積液,骨骼及軟組織無明顯異常。
